lineage.description: Building footprint polygons were extracted from the OpenStreetMap database for Nicaragua using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Raw Data API. The dataset represents volunteered geographic information with approximately 411,100 mapped buildings, estimated to cover 37% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates. The data is provided in multiple geospatial formats for use in disaster risk and humanitarian applications.
